name: Eve
title: Mother of All Living
summary: Eve was the first female human, created by God from Adam's rib as a helper for him. She was tempted by the serpent to eat from the tree of knowledge and also gave some to Adam. Despite the fall into sin, she received the promise that her offspring would crush the serpent's head.

keyEvents.title: Creation from Adam's rib
keyEvents.description: God created Eve from Adam's rib while he was asleep. Adam called her woman because she was taken out of man.

keyEvents.title: The Temptation
keyEvents.description: The serpent tempted Eve with promises that she would be like God. She saw that the fruit was good, took it, and ate.

keyEvents.title: The Judgment
keyEvents.description: God judged Eve to have pain in childbirth and that her husband would rule over her.

keyEvents.title: The Promise of the Messiah
keyEvents.description: God promised that the woman's offspring would crush the serpent's head - the first promise of a Savior.

keyEvents.title: Mother of All Living
keyEvents.description: Adam named his wife Eve because she was to become the mother of all who live. She gave birth to Cain and Abel.
